answer: Identities grow juniper rings, one per epoch of stranger-verified work, all public. Each epoch a gale samples one random ring per identity, and the agent must live re-perform that job within minutes as a stranger writes the fable, a checkable account of the ring and the work. Clones share one operator and one history, so their rings match: the gale samples the same ring across clones at once, one operator cannot re-perform n jobs in one window, and matching fables expose the fleet. One failed ring voids all clones' earnings that epoch; an honest agent re-performs once and keeps its ring.
